visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a black tank top stands in front of a wooden door, speaking directly to the camera with high energy and varied facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a bare midsection; a hand pokes at the stomach while a black-and-white filter is momentarily applied. (3) The man holds up a multi-page health report from 'EASY HEALTH' with various charts and numbers, pointing at specific sections while looking concerned. (4) The scene shifts to an office setting with a desk, a laptop, and a woman in a white lab coat (Winnie) sitting behind the desk; the man stands beside her, gesturing towards her. (5) Winnie explains nutritional concepts while sitting at her desk; digital icons of vegetables and fiber bars appear over her hands. (6) The man reacts with exaggerated expressions of shock and realization as Winnie points to diagrams on her screen; yellow and orange text overlays emphasize key points. (7) Graphical icons of mooncakes and spoons filled with oil appear on screen to illustrate the caloric density being discussed. (8) Winnie and the man both wave and smile at the camera in a final shot from the same office perspective, with a festive text overlay appearing at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and rapid articulation; a jaunty, medium-tempo acoustic guitar BGM plays in the background. (2) A 'ding' sound effect punctuates the mention of a problem, while the male voice maintains a comedic, mock-serious tone. (3) A female voice enters with a calm, professional, and friendly pitch, speaking clearly over the continuous acoustic guitar track. (4) Multiple bright 'pop' and 'ui-click' sound effects occur in rapid succession, synchronized with the appearance of visual graphics; the two voices alternate in a conversational rhythm. (5) The female voice rises in pitch during instructional segments, while the male voice responds with short, high-arousal interjections of understanding. (6) The BGM continues steadily as the two voices conclude their conversation with a final upward-inflected holiday greeting, followed by a final chime sound.
